mapper.sql: SELECT link.id AS linkId, link.domain_id AS domainId, link.created_by_user_id AS createdByUserId, domain.host, link.link_code AS linkCode, link.full_url AS targetUrl, link.status AS linkStatus, link.deleted_at AS deletedAt, link.expires_at AS expiresAt, link.created_at AS createdAt, link.revision FROM t_link link JOIN t_domain_state domain ON domain.domain_id = link.domain_id
mapper.select: SELECT domain_id AS domainId, enabled, revision FROM t_domain_state WHERE domain_id = #{domainId}

SELECT restriction_id AS restrictionId, mode, range_start AS rangeStart, range_end AS rangeEnd, reason_code AS reasonCode, created_at AS createdAt FROM t_user_link_security_restriction WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at, restriction_id
